title: Misurare l’aria della stanza
scene: Draw one small freestanding DIGITAL AIR thermometer, in a three-quarter view with a visible simple rear support, standing by itself. Its built-in air sensor housing is a couple of discreet side ventilation slots, NOT a metal food probe. Recompose the photographed device as a generic low rectangular ivory unit with softly rounded corners, one small plain button, a terracotta trim and one rectangular blank LCD. Do not copy the distinctive arched silhouette or round display of the branded reference. No plants, books, furniture, bowl or kitchen scene. The complete whole instrument and support are clearly visible. Simple matte pen drawing; it should read as a modest kitchen measuring tool, not a smart thermostat or a toy.
caption_it: Misura l’aria vicino alla zona in cui riposa l’impasto: la sua temperatura può essere diversa da quella dell’impasto.
limits: Strumento reso generico dalla fotografia ThermoWorks in ambiente interno. Nessuna lettura, precisione o soglia rappresentata; nessun modello consigliato.

title: Controllare il ripiano del frigo
target: Problemi · P21, temperatura sul ripiano usato
scene: A compact vignette of ONE short glass refrigerator shelf with a small plain DIGITAL AIR thermometer at the front-left, standing securely on the shelf, and ONE closed clear rectangular proofing tub behind/right with a modest amount of ivory dough and generous headroom. Base the instrument-on-shelf arrangement on photo2, replacing unrelated food and bottles with the lidded dough tub physically documented in photo3. Give the thermometer the same generic design as described here: low rectangular ivory body, softly rounded corners, terracotta trim, one rectangular BLANK LCD and one small plain button, simple rear support. No arched branded silhouette or round display. Built-in air sensor: no wire, needle or metal probe; it must not touch or enter the dough. The dough tub is clearly CLOSED by a plain snug pale terracotta lid; no graduations, quantities or brand. Show just the shelf edge and a small pale cool-grey refrigerator back/side corner to establish context, not a whole refrigerator, door hardware, freezer, food stock or appliance model. Entire small vignette within transparent margins. No frost, ice, condensation droplets or snowflake icon.
caption_it: Controlla la temperatura dell’aria sul ripiano usato, lasciando chiuso il recipiente. La temperatura del cuore dell’impasto può essere diversa.
limits: Scena ricomposta: termometro sul ripiano dalla foto ThermoWorks, recipiente da King Arthur Baking. La foto del recipiente non era scattata in frigorifero. Nessuna zona del frigo è dichiarata universalmente migliore.

title: Misurare la temperatura della farina
scene: A real-looking practical hand holds a GENERIC digital probe thermometer above a whole clear glass mixing bowl containing a modest mound of loose ivory FLOUR, not dough and not water. Photo2 provides the hand grip, the tool support and probe angle; photo3 provides the clear bowl and actual flour. Recompose the measurement for flour according to the source procedure, do not retain the dough in photo2. A straight thin metal probe enters the flour so that its sensing tip is visibly buried well inside the mound, with no contact with the bottom or wall. The thermometer body and the hand remain ABOVE the powder; no ingredient pouring. The powder mound is matte and broadly irregular, with 3 or 4 soft contours only, not smooth batter swirls and no speckles. No scales or scoop. Thermometer has an ivory simple non-branded body, small terracotta trim, a completely BLANK rectangular LCD, no copied proprietary folding-hinge outline. Believable hand, whole bowl visible, wrist may enter from top-right edge. No imaginary sensor values or units.
caption_it: La sonda misura la temperatura della farina, una delle variabili usate per calcolare quella dell’acqua.
limits: Gesto e strumento da Barb Alpern, farina in ciotola da PJ Hamel; la misurazione della farina è descritta nel riferimento professionale King Arthur. Non si spaccia la foto del gesto per una foto di misurazione della farina. Nessuna profondità, lettura o temperatura ottimale indicata.

title: Controllare un lievito secco dubbio
target: Problemi · P04, controllo rapido del lievito
scene: Draw ONLY ONE shallow clear glass bowl containing a small amount of pale ivory watery yeast suspension with a light, thin patchy foam layer and a handful of irregular visible medium bubbles near the perimeter. Use the LEFT bowl in photo2 for the physical liquid-and-foam appearance. Keep liquid depth low and bowl mostly empty; it is a loose suspension, NOT dough, poolish, yogurt, mashed food, thick meringue or a giant foam dome. Simplify foam into a few broad pale shapes, not hundreds of tiny dots or granular pattern. No packets, brand, spoon, cup measurements, timer, hands or extra bowls. Entire bowl visible in three-quarter view with thin warm-brown glass contours. The pictured setup illustrates an OPTIONAL freshness check for uncertain dry yeast; do not invent a visual pass/fail sign, checkmark or diagnostic comparison.
caption_it: Una prova di attività del lievito secco in acqua, utile quando si dubita della sua vitalità. Non serve eseguirla per ogni impasto.
limits: Dalla fotografia di PJ Hamel: selezionata una sola ciotola della coppia con lieviti secchi. Non rappresenta lievito fresco, bicarbonato o lievito chimico; schiuma e quantità non diventano una soglia universale.

title: Confrontare lo sviluppo dell’impasto
target: Problemi · P03/P05, osservazione dello sviluppo; Metodo · stime dei tempi
scene: TWO IDENTICAL modest terracotta bowls side by side, same viewpoint, same size, no dividing line. They show two qualitative moments of the SAME dough, based on top-left and bottom-right photographs in photo2, not two different recipes. Left bowl: smaller irregular matte ivory mound after mixing/folding, a broad band of exposed inner bowl wall around it. Right bowl: a visibly wider, gently domed smoother ivory mass spreading toward the bowl sides after rest. Use only the real relative shape change seen in the photo; do NOT exaggerate to a balloon, huge overspill or a claimed exact doubling. Same dough colour and bowl geometry in both. No hands, utensils, liquid cups, covers, rulers, graduations, labels, numbers, percent signs, arrows or clocks. Both whole bowls visible, three-quarter view rather than a schematic cross-section. A few broad dough folds and long fine contours only; no tiny dots, dense bubble map or granular skin. It is an observational comparison, not a proof of universal readiness.
caption_it: Osserva come cambia il volume nello stesso recipiente. La fine della lievitazione dipende dall’impasto e dal procedimento.
limits: Coppia ricomposta dalla sequenza fotografica di Maurizio Leo, che comprende anche pieghe tra i momenti. Non è un esperimento misurato, non isola la sola fermentazione e non dà una soglia universale di maturazione.
